text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Happy great, bonjour, and banzai NEW YEAR!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The new year has arrived, and with it, Seeking the Pearl, as she energetically bursts into my office.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's finally the start of my classic year! And as an appropriately fabulous start to the new year…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We'll need some scrumptious New Year's bento boxes! That's right! I'm going to make us a traditional New Year's meal!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I know, right?! And since it's such a special occasion, we should gather some people to come and make the lunches together as a group!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We can decide on a theme, cook dishes that go along with said theme, and then present what we've made to everyone at the end!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like that, Seeking the Pearl launches an impromptu cooking event to make a New Year's spread with friends.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, all! Today, as you're packing your New Year's bento boxes, keep in mind that your goal is to make a meal that connects the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué bueno! That's the perfect theme for someone like me who's aiming to be the strongest in the world!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna do my best to make something that'll make all the people around the world feel buono!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With us are El Condor Pasa, the Phantom Bird who dreams of soaring around the world, and Hishi Akebono, the tall culinary expert who was born overseas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're the handpicked participants for today's chosen theme, and together with Seeking the Pearl, they begin making their dishes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: My meal is complete! Just take your pick from the usual New Year's dishes, scoop them into a taco shell, and dip it into some Salsa de la Vida before diggin' in!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm finished too! My meal features a mixture of Chinese, Italian, and French cuisine. I tried adding dishes from all over the world to make it truly international!
choice_data_list: Whoa, you two are incredible! Those look delicious!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, both of you really thought outside the bento box! How innovative! Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And last but not least! Everyone, get ready to feast your eyes and taste buds on this Pearl special—the worldwide bento box!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Open sesame!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl's multi-tiered bento box holds all manner of classic New Year's foods, like sweet rolled omelets, black soybeans, herring roe, and candied sardines.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You put so much work into everything! That side dish of mashed sweet potato and chestnut is such a pretty color!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You've got a great eye, Akebono! I used gardenia fruit to color it. The candied chestnuts were made from scratch, too. I peeled them myself!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But I put a great amount of care into making the broth! It's a kelp-based soup stock complete with hand-shaved bonito flakes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Anyways, I poured a ton of attention into everything and made sure it all came out perfectly!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It all looks so deliciosa! But, um… How does your meal meet the theme of connecting people around the world?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's a fair question. The approach you two took by making foods that cater to the palates of people from different cultures was fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But I wanted to carefully and lovingly prepare a traditional Japanese meal that people everywhere can enjoy as is.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: When I was young, my parents took me all over the world to enjoy different countries' lifestyles and cultures!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And the thing I loved most from those experiences was sampling each country's soul food! It was the best way to feel the place's energy and connect with the local people!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Traditional New Year's dishes are filled with passion and wisdom passed down by many generations, which makes a New Year's bento box the local food of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: As such, I want people from other countries to taste the authentic flavors of a New Year's meal and experience the very soul of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I hope by showing people something unique about our country, we can make them understand its charm!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I formally present to you my dish—Global Bento Box Communication!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's very like you! The meal you've made and your incredible passion are both so buono! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She aims for innovation while preserving tradition. Understanding Seeking the Pearl's intent behind her bento box makes it shine all the brighter.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Okay Trainer, it's time to taste everything! ♪ Let's eat our fill of these gorgeous meals! Bon appetit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's so hard to choose what to try first from the lavish spread of assorted dishes in front of me, but I eventually make up my mind and go for…
choice_data_list: A fish-filled kelp roll for a year full of victories.
Black soybeans for a year full of health.
A sweet rolled omelet for a year full of great wisdom.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Lovely choice, Trainer! Kelp rolls symbolize happiness!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This year, I'm going to run, win, and be happy! Okay, repeat after me! Run and win and be filled with joy!
choice_data_list: Run and win and be filled with joy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That was some awesome cheering! My soul is on fire! When we're done eating, let's head to the track for our first run of the year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And just like that, the cooking party quickly turns into a training session.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You want the black soybeans? Amazing! Soybeans symbolize the desire to work diligently!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Vacations and getaways are important for maintaining a hardworking spirit!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Which means we should rest up while we can this New Year's! After we finish eating, let's lay out the futons and take a siesta!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we spend New Year's Day in a relaxed fashion, taking naps and lazing about.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sweet rolled omelets is such a haute choice! Rolled inside each one is the passionate desire for academic success!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If someone as excellent as me gains even more book smarts, that'll give me a real sledgehammer on the competition!
choice_data_list: Did you mean to say that it'll "give you a real edge"?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well! I see you're quite intelligent yourself, Trainer! I can't let myself fall behind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After enjoying the food, we spend a rather strange New Year's Day reading encyclopedias in the library.
